description: League table of a competition on betrend: position, played, won, drawn, lost, score for and against, points and recent form for every team, split into groups where the competition has them. Current season by default, or a season such as "2025/26". Includes the betrend.im standings page URL and the list of available seasons.

competition.description: Competition URL from search, or its slug together with sport.

season.description: Season name as listed in seasons, e.g. "2025/26" or "2026". Default: current season.

sport.description: Sport code; needed only when competition is a slug.

name: standings

as_of.description: When betrend produced this answer, UTC ISO 8601.

url.description: betrend.im page URL of the competition.

name.description: Group name; empty for a single table.

has_more.description: Present and true when more items exist than returned; narrow the filters.

notice.description: How to narrow the request when truncated.

seasons.description: Seasons betrend has for this competition, newest first.

truncated.description: Present and true when the longest list was cut to keep the answer under 20000 bytes.

url.description: betrend.im standings page URL for this season.

title: Competition standings
